nodes.name: WO3 electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: high-surface-area porous WO3 was synthesized by adjusting the type of stabilizer (isopropanol or ethylene glycol [EG]) and deposition temperature. Compared with isopropanol as the stabilizer (Figure 6Ai), EG induces WO3 with a rough surface and porous structure (Figure 6Aii); this phenomenon becomes more apparent with increasing EG concentration (Figure 6Aiii) and higher deposition temperature (Figure 6Aiv).
